description: Non-material amendment to planning permission 25/06611 (Erection of single storey full width rear extension; lowering of second floor rear window cill and replacement of casement windows with similar metal framed ones; conversion of front coal chute into an enclosed lightwell at ground level with flat glazed rooflight; moving the front door forward to the front of the porch; replacement of trellis fence and gate at the rear of the back garden with a 2m high rendered masonry wall incorporating a timber gate, matching the rear wall and gate at No 35) for removal of existing boiler flue and two extract ducts on front elevation,  replacement of one extract duct with air brick to match existing brickwork and replacement of other extract duct with boiler flue.***WITHDRAWN***
